segments.speaker: Kiran
segments.text: Should we move the event store from Postgres to a dedicated time series database?

segments.speaker: Aman
segments.text: Our write volume is still small, around two hundred writes per second at peak.

segments.speaker: Kiran
segments.text: True, Postgres handles that easily with partitioning.

segments.speaker: Aman
segments.text: Then we keep Postgres for now and revisit when we cross ten times this load.

segments.speaker: Kiran
segments.text: Makes sense. Nothing else from my side.
